instrument.description: Scope model name from the SerialEM `[T = SerialEM: <scope> <date>]` header of the session's raw .mdoc/.idoc files, cut before the serial number and ` at <site>` (e.g. `Glacios`; several: joined by '; '). Never the serial or site. Older lines may hold a kind (glacios_serialem / smartscope / unknown).

magnification.description: Distinct nominal magnifications (x) of the imaging images (magnification >= 5,000x; atlas files and low-mag / search maps left out)

pixel_size_a.description: Distinct PixelSpacing values (Å/px as recorded, binning included) of the imaging images (magnification >= 5,000x; atlas files and low-mag / search maps left out)

defocus_um.description: Measured Defocus (µm, SerialEM sign: negative = underfocus) of the imaging images (magnification >= 5,000x; atlas files and low-mag / search maps left out): min / median / max

target_defocus_um.description: Distinct TargetDefocus values (µm) of the imaging images (magnification >= 5,000x; atlas files and low-mag / search maps left out)

dose.description: ExposureDose per image (e/Å²) of the imaging images (magnification >= 5,000x; atlas files and low-mag / search maps left out), 0 (not calibrated) left out: min / median / max

binning.description: Distinct camera Binning values of the imaging images (magnification >= 5,000x; atlas files and low-mag / search maps left out)

acq_dates.description: First and last image DateTime over all the session's raw .mdoc/.idoc files (scope clock). May fall on the next day (20260827-2 was acquired on 2026-08-28; the session id is the folder's date)

n_mdoc.description: Raw metadata sidecar files read for the session: .mdoc AND .idoc (atlas files included). Raw folder: `2. Raw images/`, or the session's older layout (importers.RAW_LAYOUT)

n_imaging.description: Non-atlas sidecar files with imaging images (magnification >= 5,000x): the files behind the per-image stats

n_other.description: Non-atlas sidecar files with no imaging image (only low-mag / search captures)

other_magnification.description: Distinct magnifications (x) of non-atlas images below 5,000x (low-mag, e.g. 2,600x search maps), left out of the stats

acquisition_gap.description: Why the acquisition fields are missing or partial (no raw folder, parser not found, unreadable files)

sample_labels.description: scope slot -> sample label, from the session's sample_key.csv

session_grids.description: scope slot -> inventory Grid# (null if unknown)

local_folder.description: Session folder, as `<processing root name>/<session id>`

logged.description: Time this line was written. Last line per id is current.

status_by.description: people.json id of whoever set this status explicitly (registry.py set-status); explicit beats derived

conversions.description: Portal raw-upload conversions of this session (portal/upload_sessions.py; upload-owned: the importer carries it forward). id = predict/raw_tiles/<id>; uploaded_by = portal user id (not `owner`, which names an owner file); grids / sample_labels / tiles_per_grid / n_tiles from its MANIFEST.csv; acquisition = the session/1 acquisition keys from its acquisition.json

details.description: Session details typed in the portal for an uploaded session (upload-owned: the importer carries it forward): scope slot -> grid id as typed, scope slot -> sample name shown (tile names unchanged), prep notes, who and when
